description: This file defines a SwiftUI ViewModifier that presents an alert prompting the user to trust a gateway during a TLS connection. It interacts with a GatewayConnectionController to manage trust prompts and adds an extension to View to easily attach the alert.

classes.name: GatewayTrustPromptAlert
classes.description: A SwiftUI ViewModifier that presents a trust prompt alert during gateway connections, handling user responses to trust or decline the connection.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Constructs the view body that presents an alert based on the pending trust prompt.

methods.name: promptBinding
methods.description: Provides a binding to the current trust prompt, preventing race conditions by not modifying the setter.
